ios.desc:
With our app, you'll feel better, see more clearly, and keep your eyes in the best possible condition. We will help you forget about eye strain from gadgets and computers. Download the app and feel the difference!

Simple but effective massages and exercises for your eyesight: Our exercises are easy to do and will bring you noticeable relief and improvement in your vision

Our handy timer helps you do your eye exercises and massages easily and conveniently

Profile to track your progress: Profile helps you to track and analyze your progress and achievements on the way to better vision

Join us today and give your eyes the best!

All exercises and recommendations are taken from open sources on the Internet. If you have any health problems, please consult your doctor or other qualified healthcare professional
